title: ‘काम्यो लुग्लुग त्यो’ कविताको सङ्कथन विश्लेषण
nepali: पाठको अध्ययन गर्ने भाषाविज्ञानको एउटा महŒवपूर्ण अङ्गका रूपमा सङ्कथन विश्लेषणलाई लिइन्छ । यस लेखमा सङ्कथन विश्लेषण गर्नका निम्ति भीमनिधि तिवारीको ‘काम्यो लुग्लुग त्यो’ शीर्षकको कविता छनोट गरिएको छ । सङ्कथन विश्लेषण गर्ने उद्देश्यले कविताबाट शब्दगत, वाक्यगत तथा श्लोकगत तथ्यलाई आधार बनाई असम्भावनात्मक नमुना छनोट पद्धतिअनुसार तथ्य सङ्कलन गरिएको छ । सङ्कथनमा प्रयुक्त संसक्ति विश्लेषण र सन्दर्भपरक विश्लेषण गर्न गुणात्मक पद्धतिको प्रयोग गरिएको छ । माघ महिनाको चिसो मौसममा गरिब वर्गको प्रतिनिधि पात्रले भोगेका दुःख, दर्दहरूलाई मार्मिक तथा कारुणिक ढङ्गले यस फुटकर रचनामा प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ । सङ्कथनको विषयवस्तुका रूपमा नेपाली समाजको सामाजिक स्तरमा प्रत्यक्ष देखिने यथार्थ घटना आएको छ । यस कवितामा उठान गरिएको विषयवस्तु करिब छ दशकपछि व्यवस्थाको परिवर्तनअनुसार जनताको अवस्थामा परिवर्तन नआएको वर्तमानपरिप्रेक्षमा पनि उत्तिकै सान्दर्भिक छ । यस कविताले आजको मानिसले निर्दयीपन त्यागेर आपसी सहयोगमा जुट्न सक्नुपर्छ भन्ने सन्देश दिनुका साथै कवितामार्पmत सर्जकले सामाजिक परिवेशको बेमेलको स्थितिलाई प्रस्तुत गरी अप्रत्यक्ष रूपमा परिवर्तन तथा समानताको अपेक्षा र आह्वान पनि गरेका छन् । यो लेख सामान्यतया सन्दर्भ विश्लेषण र कविताको विश्लेषणसँग सम्बन्धित अनुसन्धानकर्ता, शिक्षक र विद्यार्थी आदिलाई सहयोगी सामग्री बन्न सक्छ भन्ने अपेक्षा गरिएको छ ।
american_english:
Discourse analysis is regarded as an important branch of linguistics for the study of a text.
In this article, the poem titled 'Kaamyo Luglug Tyo' by Bhimnidhi Tiwari has been selected for discourse analysis.
For the purpose of discourse analysis, facts have been collected from the poem on the basis of word-level, sentence-level and stanza-level data, following a purposive sampling method.
To analyze the cohesion used in the discourse and the contextual analysis, a qualitative method has been employed.
In this free verse, the sorrows and sufferings experienced by a representative character of the poor class in the cold weather of the month of Magh have been presented in a touching and pathetic manner.
As the subject matter of the discourse, a real event directly visible at the social level of Nepali society has emerged.
The subject raised in this poem remains equally relevant in the present context, in which, even after nearly six decades and a change of system, no change has come about in the condition of the people.
This poem gives the message that today's people must be able to shed cruelty and come together in mutual cooperation, and through the poem the creator has also presented the mismatched state of the social environment, indirectly calling for and expecting change and equality.
It is expected that this article can become a helpful material for researchers, teachers and students related to contextual analysis and the analysis of poetry in general.

informal_english: In this piece, discourse analysis is treated as an important branch of linguistics for studying a text. I selected Bhimnidhi Tiwari's poem 'Kaamyo Luglug Tyo' for discourse analysis. To do the analysis, I gathered facts from the poem at word, sentence and stanza level, using purposive sampling. I used a qualitative method to look at the cohesion in the discourse and the context. The poem presents, in a touching and pathetic way, the sorrows and sufferings of a representative poor character in the cold Magh weather. As the subject matter, a real event directly visible in Nepali society's social fabric comes through. The issue raised stays just as relevant now, even after nearly six decades and a change of government, since the people's condition hasn't changed. The poem gives the message that today's people need to drop their cruelty and work together, and through it the poet also presents the mismatch in the social environment, indirectly calling for change and equality. I hope this article will be a useful resource for researchers, teachers and students interested in contextual and poetry analysis.
